features.description:
One member per feature a deployment can turn off, `true` while the feature is on. A
feature this API doesn't have is absent.

Features.description: No feature can be turned off yet.

FieldError.description: One field of a request that failed validation (API-07, API-10).

code.description: Why the field failed, as a stable `snake_case` code, such as `too_long`.

field.description: The JSON Pointer of the field, such as `/email`.

message.description: The reason, for humans. Clients act on `code`, never on this (ERR-09).

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem, with the error's stable code and the request's trace ID.

detail.description: A sentence about this occurrence, for humans. Clients act on `code`, never on this.

errors.description: The fields that failed validation, present only for a validation failure.

title.description: A short summary, the same for every occurrence of the code.

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request.

email_verified.description: Whether the user proved they receive email at the address.

RefreshRequest.description: What refreshing takes: the refresh token, unless a browser's cookie holds it (AUTH-010).

refresh_token.description: The session's current refresh token. A browser leaves it out, and its cookie carries it.

oneOf.description: An ID the client keeps for its installation (AUTH-008, AUTH-017).

Session.description: A session, as its client sees it.

oneOf.description: The device ID the client signed in with, if any.

expires_at.description: When the session ends, whatever its refreshes.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When its refresh token expires, unless a refresh slides it.

user_id.description: The user the session signs in.

SessionResponse.description: A session, and its tokens when they go in the body.

access_token.description: The access token, unless the tokens went in cookies.

oneOf.description: The device ID the client signed in with, if any.

expires_at.description: When the session ends, whatever its refreshes.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token, unless the tokens went in cookies.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When its refresh token expires, unless a refresh slides it.

user_id.description: The user the session signs in.

oneOf.description: An ID the client keeps for its installation (AUTH-008, AUTH-017).
